_doc: Allowlist of tests/test_see_through.py (T273): holes in a building's shell that are there on purpose.
Key: the asset name without its generation letter (SkiLodgeAFrameW -> SkiLodgeAFrame).
Entry: box [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1] in the asset frame the test prints (meters, Z up, grade z = 0, arrival
face toward -Y), the hole's gap point must lie inside it; optional lods [0, 1]; why (required: what the
opening is and why an architect left it open). A ray through an intended opening normally meets front faces
(posts, the wall behind, the ground), so an entry here is rare: only a single-sided part seen from its back
on purpose, or a face that another mesh of the same prefab draws, belongs here.
requires (for a face another mesh draws): the export folder's <Name>.manifest.json must list exactly these
faces under manifest_key, their bounds_game must lie inside the box, and the hole must lie on them (+- gap_tol_m).
If any of that drifts, the hole FAILS with the reason: an entry never allowlists a new hole silently.

SkiWelcomeSign.why: Not a hole in the game: the header beam's front between y -/+HEADER_Y is the sign set's three faces (welcome_sign.py, fine-detail step 3d: sign_gateflakeL_face / sign_gate_face / sign_gateflakeR_face are routed to the separate sign-set mesh, which the prefab draws there). The main mesh has no face there by design.

SkiLodgeSwankyBottom.why: The cross-gable ridge miter at the apex of the wing cross gables (ridge_xgwn at +x, ridge_xgws at -x): the ridge cap meets the two rake boards in a miter that leaves a sliver open at the apex (gate: about 4-9 px at 20 m). The owner accepted the L5 miter as built (OWNER-REVIEW-1.0.4: "L5 wire triangle / miter / slate blotches: fine", lead ruling 2026-11-21). The box holds only the apex, so any other hole there still fails.
